title: Plasma Globe Sorcerer
description: A lone figure in a dark coat stands inside a large glowing plasma globe, holding two bright orange orbs that emit electric arcs. Green slime and vibrant pink-blue plasma bursts explode outward from the glass sphere, with additional plasma orbs floating outside connected by lightning tendrils.
prompt: A mysterious figure in a long dark coat stands inside a large transparent plasma globe filled with green bubbling liquid, holding two glowing orange spheres that shoot lightning bolts. Bright pink and blue plasma orbs float outside the globe, connected by electric arcs, with vibrant green slime dramatically dripping and splattering from the bursts against a dark background.
